ideas.name: Rank-Weighted Currency Carry
ideas.claim: Rank currencies by carry, go long high-carry currencies and short low-carry currencies, and rebalance monthly.
ideas.quote: We begin with the classic carry trade studied in the literature—the currency carry trade—which is a trade that goes long high carry currencies and short low carry currencies.

rules.entry: Go long high-carry currencies and short low-carry currencies; weight each currency by its carry rank.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports that carry positively predicts currency returns.

ideas.name: High-Minus-Low Currency Carry
ideas.claim: Sort currencies into monthly portfolios by forward discount, then go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.
ideas.mechanism: Cross-sectional currency carry from forward discounts

rules.market: Currencies, including developed and emerging markets
rules.entry: Sort currencies by forward discount; go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency baskets.
